target.description: Liveness property to verify. A target constrains the route as the given location sees it: at a node, that is after the node's import policy has run. Contrast the assumptions below, which constrain routes as a neighbor sent them.

location.description: Location to verify property at within network

assumption_locations.description: Locations where you make assumption about traffic

assumptions.description: Assumptions made about traffic, should be one-to-one with assumption_locations. An assumption on an edge constrains the route as the neighbor sent it, before BGP's own export transformations: BGP resets the weight, and on an EBGP session also resets the local preference to 100 and prepends the neighbor's ASN. So an assumed AS-path length of N arrives as N+1, and an assumed local preference is ignored on an EBGP session.

default_assumption.description: Default assumption on incoming edges, if not specified. As with assumptions, this constrains the route as the neighbor sent it, before BGP's own export transformations.

ingress.description: Optional starting point for incoming traffic

exact_communities.description: Flag indicating if communities provided should be treated as exact

compute_data_plane.description: Flag indicating if data plane should be computed (more robust, but expensive)
